Messages.Author: Stephen Beaulieu
Messages.Body:
In article <4lgiue$j...@dinkel.civ.utwente.nl>,
j.p.a....@student.utwente.nl (Philippus Baalman) wrote:

: Hello, I have a question,

:
: do I have to strike in combat, or can I choose not to strike at all?
:
: Philippus

You must choose a strike in combat. If you do not wish to play a strike
card (or use a weapon) than you must strike with hands. Note that this
applies regardless of the range of combat. If you are at long range
without a ranged strike, you are still (technically) striking with hands.

I hope this helps

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
j.p.a....@student.utwente.nl (Philippus Baalman) writes:
>do I have to strike in combat, or can I choose not to strike at all?

You must choose a strike.
If you have no other options, you must use your inherent (hand) strike -
usually for one point of damage (or zero, if at long range).

Note that you can choose a strike that has no effect (such as 'hands'
at long range, or 'strike: destroy weapon' when your opponent has no
weapons).
